decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 15th November 2006, the erection of a single storey side and rear extension to a house, giving a total volume increase to the original house of 45.96m3, as shown on drawing number P06-40, received 15th November 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informative:
The proposed side and rear extension will only be lawful if it is completed prior to the commencement of any other extensions to the house that would result in the cubic content of the original house being increased by an aggregate  total of more than 50m3. Failure to observe this will result in a breach of planning control and the risk of enforcement action being taken.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for erection of a single storey side and rear extension to the existing house
